children: Terry Briggs, Chief Development Officer, sold 6,138 AngloGold Ashanti ordinary shares on November 24, 2026, at $77.1923 per share, and 7,484 shares on November 25, 2026, at $72.11 per share, for total proceeds of $1,013,478. The sales satisfied tax withholding obligations related to the exercise of deferred share plan awards. Following the transactions, Briggs directly owned 42,032 ordinary shares, 34,561 deferred share plan awards, 5,886 restricted stock units and 7,287 transition share plan awards.
